text: NO EFFECT: In iPSC-derived astrocytes, LysoTracker-labelled lysosomes did not differ significantly at baseline between ApoE4/4 (AD donor) and ApoE3/3 (normal-aging donor) cells.
description: Human iPSC-derived astrocytes. Lines came from an ApoE4/4 AD subject and an ApoE3/3 normal-aging subject; they are not isogenic. NPCs were MACS-purified and differentiated to astrocytes, then stained with LysoTracker red and imaged by confocal microscopy. N = 4-5/condition per Methods. Caveat: lysosomal size/number, not endosomal pH. Genotype is confounded with AD status and donor. Data are shown only in supplementary figures (S6D-E) and stated in text without statistics.

provenance.excerpt: However, no significant differences were seen in lysosomes of ApoE4+/+ astrocytes with miR-195 treatment when compared to control, or between ApoE4+/+ versus ApoE3+/+ astrocytes at baseline.

meccogFinding.summary: (APOE3 -> APOE4) -> (no change in LysoTracker-labelled lysosome size/number in human iPSC-derived astrocytes) [NO EFFECT]

perturbed.variable: APOE genotype of iPSC donor (ApoE4/4 AD subject vs ApoE3/3 normal-aging subject); astrocytes

measured.variable: LysoTracker-labelled lysosome phenotypes (size, diameter distribution) in iPSC-derived astrocytes
